sections.name: Docs hub
sections.description: The front door of the help center: a one-sentence hero over a prominent search field with a keyboard hint, a start-here row of popular guides, then lifecycle-ordered category cards (icon, title, one-line subtitle, article count). Progressive disclosure: quick starts first, full taxonomy below.

usedBy.note: Start-here hero, use-case columns, then Browse-by-product card sections grouped into 4-5 categories
One-sentence value prop hero, four lifecycle-ordered category cards (Get started, Manage, Expand, Reference)
Popular row of 4 guides above a Basics grid; consistent title + subtitle card format
Big search under a brand-line heading; 14 collection cards each with icon and article count

props.name: heading
props.doc: One-sentence hero line stating what the docs cover

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: The search field is the primary CTA of the page

props.doc: Keyboard hint rendered as a Kbd cap at the field's end; empty string hides it

props.name: popular
props.doc: Start-here row of popular guides; empty array hides the row

props.name: categories
props.doc: Lifecycle-ordered category cards; glyph is one of bolt | plug | sliders | book | spark | person

sections.name: Status band
sections.description: A slim system-status strip: one dot, one plain sentence, one timestamp, a 90-day uptime number, and per-service dots using the fixed operational / degraded / outage vocabulary. Embed it on docs and support pages and link out to the full status history; never duplicate incident detail inline.

usedBy.note: Overall banner, per-component list, incident history below
Help surface links out to status and support entry points from footer
Developer-trust surface pairs API proof with transparency links

props.name: services
props.doc: Per-service dots; status is the fixed vocabulary operational | degraded | outage

sections.name: Developer proof band
sections.description: Proves the product is programmable: hard numbers first (endpoints, p95 latency, uptime), a quiet single-color SDK and MCP pill row, and a code-ish pane built entirely from tokens with language tabs and a runnable-looking snippet. Primary CTA routes to the API reference, secondary to a key.

usedBy.note: 9 official SDKs, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, migration guides; trust through openness and specifics
CLI banner ('run stripe docs in your terminal') and AI/agent skills as first-class entry points
CLI/API reference surfaced as a top-level category alongside user guides

sections.name: Support entry
sections.description: A help-center entry that triages before it converses: search first, an all-systems status line so 'is it down?' never becomes a ticket, then three honestly-scoped routes (browse docs, ask Alfred, email a human) each with a stated response time. The assistant route carries the brand ring; the human route is present but ranked last.

usedBy.note: Search-led hero ('Great service changes everything'), collection cards, then contact routes
Search plus guides/reference split, with contact support as the last resort route
Support channels folded into the Resources and reference category rather than a competing surface
